reuse.why: Fintegra shares linking, downloading and balance calculation with existing providers, while replacement reuses the extracted local unlink operation.

duplication.why: The change removes repeated linking and transaction-download workflows and centralizes holder lookup and link clearing.

placement.why: Database link checks remain in accounts/link.ts, orchestration in accounts/app.ts and provider downloads in accounts/sync.ts.

scope.why: The edits support the four requested changes, with frontend additions limited to accommodating the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: The shared workflows are straightforward, although refuseIfBankAccountLinked now performs replacement orchestration beyond the validation its name suggests.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six registered linking handlers use the shared policy wrapper, and replacement and ordinary unlinking share clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated provider workflows are extracted into shared functions rather than renamed or reshaped into additional copies.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink adds one shared option and one replacement branch to refuseIfBankAccountLinked; no provider-specific exceptions or bypassing callers are introduced.
